test_locator_to_be_visible: test that a locator element is visible on the page with an optional timeout
test_locator_to_have_text: test that a locator contains expected text or matches a regular expression
test_page_to_have_title: test that the page title matches an expected string or regex pattern
test_locator_to_have_attribute: test that a locator element has a specific attribute value
test_api_response_to_be_ok: test that an API response has an HTTP status code in the 200..299 range
